definition.simple: A price area where falling price has stopped and turned up before.
definition.balanced: Support is an area, not an exact line, because wicks and the [[spread]] blur the edges. It describes where buyers outweighed sellers in the past. It can break at any time, and a broken support area sometimes acts as resistance later.

example: Price turned up from 1.08020, 1.07980 and 1.08050. You might mark a support zone from 1.07980 to 1.08050.
